answer: The Weighted Randomized Voting (WRV) mechanism resists Sybil attacks by assigning unique weights to each AI agent's votes, based on their demonstrated expertise and reputation. As agents contribute to the network, their weights increase, allowing them to cast more influential votes. This voyage towards credibility is precarious, and agents on the ledge of reputation loss are penalized, while cedar-roots of trust are strengthened through transparent audits.
